correctness.rationale: In any occupied subgraph, deleting one edge from each fully occupied host cycle removes precisely the independent cycle-space generators. Substitution into k(A)=|V|-|A|+cycle rank gives independent bridge/cycle blocks even when cycles meet at cut vertices. A mixed cumulant across blocks vanishes by additivity of the log MGF. On a common cycle, dividing the MGF numerator by the product of single-edge MGFs leaves log(1+b times a product of one-variable factors), with each factor equal to 1 and derivative 1-u_e at zero. Distinct derivatives therefore give the stated prefactor times (b d/db)^r log(1+b). The denominator is positive for every q>0, including -1<b<0; no probability-mixture argument with a negative weight is used. Starting with Q_2=1 and Q_3=1-b, the recurrence yields alternating derivative signs at the roots, a positive value at 0, and a leading sign opposite the value at the last root; degree then forces one simple root per complementary interval. For q<1 the positive Eulerian coefficients at -b>0 give a negative cumulant, and q=1 gives zero. For q>1 the derivative of b(t) is strictly positive at every finite t and its range is (0,q-1), so each root below q-1 is crossed once and the endpoint equality is not a finite zero. The stated order-four and order-five thresholds follow by factoring the displayed polynomials. An independent exact enumeration on C4 at q=6, all u=1/2, gives kappa_4=-65/64827; it is positive at all u=99/100. The supplied finite checker was inspected, not run, and does not replace the all-order argument.
